title: The Death Mage
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hiroto Amamiya dies with his class in a boat accident while trying to save a girl, and a god of reincarnation sends the dead students to another world, but a mistake leaves Hiroto with nothing except a huge mana pool, and his second life ends cruelly. Cursed by the god in hope that a third life would end quickly, he is reborn as a dhampir, half vampire and half dark elf, and resolves to survive this life with death magic so he never needs a fourth.
life_message: An outcast who has been wronged again and again can still build a life and a people of his own, by his own power.
